reviews.text: I paid for the app a long time ago to use for the companies I work for. The app sucks because I can’t do anything now. Every time I try to add photos, add logos, the app crashes on me. And yes, I reached out to their support who sent me a list of things to try, which I did, and none of them worked, and it’s been currently 2 weeks since I’ve heard from anyone. I’d honestly like my money back since the app isn’t even usable at this point for what it was made for…

reviews.title: WTH IS GOING ON??
reviews.text: Not cool lighttricks, I’ve had this app for over 4 years now and I use it to promote my nonprofit organization and meetings. And just unsubscribed from my premium subscription of $14.99 a month which is on auto pay for today, but every time I get on my app it kicks me off!! I’ve troubleshooted in every way possible and still no luck! I have a project I need to get done today and Boosted was the one I always turn to out of several apps I have because it’s quick and easy to use!! I’m so not happy right now!! Pay for a subscription and only got to use it once this month is crazy!! I even went to your website for support and see Boosted is not listed with the other that is by Lightricks! Noticed the other app I’ve used for over a decade now. And I see the last update in the Apple App Store was from 4 years ago??!! Not that I need anything to change other than this app to work as it should!! Please get this fixed ASAP.

reviews.title: Extremely Disappointed
reviews.text: I have had this app for many years and have recently been experiencing terrible tech issues.  I keep getting kicked out of the app every time I try to upload my own media.  I have dented the app, restarted my phone, made sure everything was on the latest update, AND contacted tech support but the generic response didn’t help.  I’m a paid premium subscriber and will now have to unsubscribe.  I need this app to promote my donation drive.  Really disappointed!!
